notes.title: GUNGUNGUN 1.3 UPDATE + BIG NEWS :)
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28072620/78539e99e38fe58485c24f92c3f62cfbb58ff423.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28072620/78539e99e38fe58485c24f92c3f62cfbb58ff423.gif[/img][/url]

Heya guys, long time no talk. Got some big news for everyone!

[h2]1.3 Release Notes[/h2]
- Engine updated to GMStudio 2 (save files and progress should be unaffected)
- Some hats have been replaced with newer, shinier hats!
- Hats are now more reasonably priced
- Misc. game logic and rare crash causes fixed

[h2]Also....[/h2]

The Gun Gals were featured in a [b]crossover comic with Tom n Artie![/b] Check our feature and read the full series on Tapas here: https://tapas.io/episode/1322038?fbclid=IwAR1dyBawFI_kYmHx0hAzlkFcazPCMu5NRlWQDF7hFDKiQkpV81UrVXuBMDo

[url=https://tapas.io/episode/1322038?fbclid=IwAR1dyBawFI_kYmHx0hAzlkFcazPCMu5NRlWQDF7hFDKiQkpV81UrVXuBMDo][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28072620/79ae3dea5c12d46e7b528d29ca06d4c6c23cc8ba.png[/img][/url]

[h2]And in other news....[/h2]

[h1]GUNGUNGUN is now available for digital purchase on SWITCH, PLAYSTATION 4, and PLAYSTATION 5![/h1]

[h3]Pick up a copy for portable or big screen play![/h3]
SWITCH

PLAYSTATION 4 and PLAYSTATION 5

[h2]and ICYMI:[/h2]

[h3]Mystery Egg Games is now working on a new title: [b]HERO.EXE[/b]![/h3]

Follow our progress on our socials and Steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302770/HeroEXE/

notes.title: GUNGUNGUN 1.0 Release
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that GUNGUNGUN has finally reached 1.0! 
The core game is complete. Steam Trading Cards and Achievements are now available.

Thank you everyone for your support!

This release does not mark the end of development for GUNGUNGUN; 
we are working on even more content updates that will be released for free! Including:

- Alternate Game Modes
- Prologue with intro Cutscene
- Detailed Gun Gallery
- Additional Cosmetic items


Stay tuned for more content Updates!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28072620/652ebd5d60b2b3e3269b2b16b33cb3e01013f16c.png[/img]
1.0 Release Notes:

- 50 achievements added 
- 8 Steam trading cards added
- Additional stats now tracked
- Added lifetime stat tracking
- Added stats screen in extras
- Enemies no longer slide across ground after death
- Changed initialization of save file to prevent first time launch crash
- End game stat screen now displays kills per gun instead of shots per gun
- Added Hunter hat and Wizard hat
- Adjusted trigger conditions of certain achievements
- Pickup despawns are now signified with flying guns
- Gun pickup name changes
- Added unique bullets for Stechkin and USP9
- Fixed audio not playing on some menu buttons

notes.title: Patch BETA 0.96
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

- Added P1 and P2 equipped indicators to Hat menu
- Adjusted price of hats (subject to balancing)
- Added 30 second timer to dropped items before they dissappear (subject to balancing)
- Fixed easy kill funnel exploit in arena 9
- Added Beta branch to Steam for testing builds.

All player provided feedback will help us shape future updates. Thank you for your continued support!
